app_ethos: (No product intent provided — analyze the codebase and suggest improvements based on what you see.)

nodes.title: Modularize Python MCP Core
nodes.description: The monolithic MCP server.py (2416 lines) and orchestrator.py (2545 lines) are critical bottlenecks blocking team velocity and creating single points of failure in the AI integration layer.

tasks.description: Extract tool handlers from server.py into domain-specific modules (tools/search.py, tools/edit.py, tools/context.py)
Decompose PipelineOrchestrator into discrete stage managers (IndexStage, RetrieveStage, GenerateStage)
Define protocol interfaces between MCP server and pipeline layers to enforce separation of concerns

nodes.title: Break Cross-Package Import Cycles
nodes.description: 61 detected import cycles between ui, rag, dashboard, and vscode-extension domains prevent independent testing, create fragile builds, and block modular deployment.

tasks.description: Create packages/shared-types for common interfaces to break circular dependencies between dashboard and vscode
Refactor TEST2/website.clean to remove deep dependency sink by extracting shared utilities to packages/common
Implement barrel export linting rules to prevent index.ts circular references in packages/ui

nodes.title: Consolidate Package Management
nodes.description: Multiple oversized lock files (687KB root, 614KB packages/ui) indicate workspace misconfiguration, causing dependency drift and inflated CI times across the monorepo.

tasks.description: Migrate npm to pnpm workspaces with hoist-pattern configuration to share dependencies across packages/ui and dashboard
Extract docs/Phase13_Storybook/theme-examples into standalone templates or use stackblitz links to remove 116KB lockfile

nodes.title: Documentation Architecture Cleanup
nodes.description: MASTER_TODO.md (2683 lines) and ENTERPRISE_ADMIN_DESIGN.md (2336 lines) have become unmaintainable knowledge silos that block onboarding and hide critical architectural decisions.

tasks.description: Migrate MASTER_TODO.md to GitHub Projects or structured Phase indices with automated TOC generation
Convert ENTERPRISE_ADMIN_DESIGN.md into Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in docs/adr/

nodes.title: Unify Multi-Interface Component Layer
nodes.description: VSCode webview-ui (14 files) and Tauri dashboard (35 files) currently duplicate logic instead of leveraging the 224-file design system, creating inconsistent UX and double maintenance.

tasks.description: Audit component duplication between webview-ui, dashboard, and packages/ui to identify migration candidates
Create platform adapters in packages/ui to bridge VSCode API vs Tauri API differences without forking components

nodes.title: Local-First Sync Hardening
nodes.description: As a local-first application, the sync mechanism requires robust conflict resolution and corruption recovery to prevent data loss when the AI assistant modifies codebases.

tasks.description: Implement CRDT or last-write-wins conflict resolution for local-first sync in the root orchestration layer
Add telemetry hooks for sync failure modes that respect local-first privacy constraints

questions.question: What is the intended boundary between the Rust codrag-graph engine and the Python pipeline services? Should the Python orchestrator migrate to Rust for performance, or remain as the MCP tool host with Rust handling only graph analysis?
questions.context: The codebase has a Rust engine (codrag-graph) but heavy Python services (239 files) with monolithic orchestrator.py. Without clarity on which runtime owns the core AI logic, refactoring risks creating FFI complexity or performance bottlenecks.

questions.question: Should TEST2/website.clean remain in the monorepo or be extracted to a separate repository?
questions.context: TEST2/website.clean is identified as a deep dependency sink across all entry points, suggesting tight coupling between marketing content and application logic. This impacts build isolation and security audit scope.

questions.question: Is the VSCode extension intended to be the primary interface with the Tauri dashboard as a secondary view, or should the Tauri dashboard eventually subsume the VSCode webview functionality?
questions.context: Both interfaces share similar React implementations but have separate entry points (packages/vscode/webview-ui vs src/codrag/dashboard). The product strategy determines whether to invest in unification or allow divergence.
